description: ML-01 is the official RTO code designated specifically for registration of Meghalaya Government vehicles. Headquartered in Shillong, this series is used for the state's official fleet, including vehicles used by the Chief Minister, ministers, and various government departments.
address: Regional Transport Office, Lower Lachumiere, Shillong, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-02 RTO code is a specialized registration series reserved exclusively for vehicles belonging to the Meghalaya Police Department. While general public vehicles in Shillong use ML-05, the ML-02 series is used for state-wide law enforcement and departmental vehicle administration.
address: Office of the District Transport Officer, East Khasi Hills District, Shillong, Meghalaya

description: ML-03 is a specialized registration code in Meghalaya assigned exclusively to the Meghalaya Transport Corporation (MTC) and state-owned commercial transport vehicles. Centrally managed from the capital city of Shillong, it distinguishes corporate-owned public transport from private civilian registrations.
address: Regional Transport Office, Shillong, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-04 RTO serves as the District Transport Office (DTO) for Jowai, located in the West Jaintia Hills district. It is the first geographical registration code in Meghalaya's numbering system, handling vehicle registration, driving licenses, and permit services for the region.
address: District Transport Office, Jowai, West Jaintia Hills District, Meghalaya

description: The ML-05 RTO serves the East Khasi Hills district, headquartered in the state capital of Shillong. This District Transport Office is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and enforcement of transport regulations within the state capital and surrounding areas. It is one of the primary and most active transport hubs in the state of Meghalaya.
address: District Transport Office, New Administrative Building, Lower Lachumiere, Shillong, East Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-06 RTO is the District Transport Office (DTO) for the West Khasi Hills district in Meghalaya, headquartered in Nongstoin. It handles all statutory functions of the Motor Vehicles Act, including vehicle registration, driver licensing, and road tax collection for the western Khasi region.
address: District Transport Office, Nongstoin, West Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-07 District Transport Office (DTO) is the primary vehicle registration and licensing authority for the East Garo Hills district in Meghalaya. Located in the headquarters of Williamnagar, it manages transport-related services including commercial permits and road safety regulations for the eastern Garo Hills region.
address: District Transport Office, Williamnagar, East Garo Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-08 Regional Transport Office (RTO) serves the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya, with its administrative headquarters in Tura. It is responsible for various transport-related services including vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and collection of road taxes in the Garo Hills region.
address: District Transport Office, Tura, West Garo Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-09 RTO serves the South Garo Hills district in Meghalaya, with its headquarters located in Baghmara. It is responsible for vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of transport regulations across the district's diverse terrain near the international border.
address: District Transport Office, Baghmara, South Garo Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-10 RTO serves the Ri-Bhoi district of Meghalaya, with its headquarters situated in Nongpoh. It handles vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and transport permit management for the critical region connecting Shillong to the Assam border.
address: District Transport Office, Nongpoh, Ri-Bhoi District, Meghalaya

description: The ML-11 RTO serves the East Jaintia Hills district with its headquarters in Khliehriat, Meghalaya. It provides essential services like vehicle registration, driving licenses, and road tax collection for the coal-rich Jaintia region. The office was established following the bifurcation of the Jaintia Hills district in 2012.
address: District Transport Office, Dkhiah West, Khliehriat, East Jaintia Hills, Meghalaya

description: The ML-12 RTO serves the South West Khasi Hills district in Meghalaya, based in Mawkyrwat. It handles vehicle registration, driver licensing, and enforcement of the Motor Vehicles Act within this hill region. It was established following the bifurcation of the West Khasi Hills district to improve administrative reach.
address: District Transport Office (DTO), Mawkyrwat, South West Khasi Hills, Meghalaya

description: ML-13 is the District Transport Office (DTO) serving Resubelpara and the surrounding North Garo Hills district in Meghalaya. It manages all transport-related activities including vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of road safety regulations for the district.
address: District Transport Office, Resubelpara, North Garo Hills District, Meghalaya
